lists.title: Choose lists to sync
lists.description: Enter the Google Keep list names to sync, separated by commas (e.g. `Groceries, Chores`). Each becomes a Home Assistant to-do list. If a list with that title doesn't exist yet in Keep, it will be created.

error.no_lists_selected: Enter at least one list title.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach Google to look up the account's email address.
abort.missing_configuration: The integration is not configured. Set up an OAuth application credential first (see the README).
abort.missing_credentials: You need an application credential configured before adding this integration - see the README for how to register one in Google Cloud Console.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The re-authenticated account does not match the original account.

application_credentials.description:
To link your Google account, you need an OAuth client registered in Google Cloud Console with the Google Keep API enabled:
1. Go to the [Google Cloud Console credentials page]({oauth_creds_url}) and create an OAuth client ID of type 'Web application', with redirect URI `https://my.home-assistant.io/redirect/oauth`.
2. Enable the [Keep API]({keep_api_url}) for that project.
3. On the [OAuth consent screen]({oauth_consent_url}), add scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep`, add your Google account as a test user, then set publishing status to **In production** (this avoids Google's 7-day token expiry for apps left in Testing - you'll still see an 'unverified app' warning to click through, which is expected for a personal-use app under 100 users).
4. Enter the Client ID and Client Secret from step 1 below.
